clips.title: The story
paras: In Baradin Bay, reefs and wrecks make each crossing perilous. Its waters lie between Khaz Modan, the Wetlands, the Arathi Highlands, and southern Lordaeron. Kul Tiras once patrolled the bay with a powerful navy during the Second War.

Baradin Bay links the harbors of the Eastern Kingdoms. Menethil Harbor lies on its Wetlands shore, and Southshore stands in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Shallow sandbanks and jagged shoals threaten ships, as do murlocs, crocolisks, and deep-sea sharks.

During the Second War, Kul Tiras and the Horde fought across Baradin Bay. The broken hulls of the Kul Tiran Third Fleet, called the Lost Fleet, lie half-submerged along the Wetlands coast. Other ships sank at Drowned Reef. Hostile spirits, salvagers, and sea beasts haunt the waters around the ruined ships.
